title: workflow.jsonl row
description: One editor, code or build operation of the game's creation, written when it happened. workflow.jsonl holds one such object per line, in order. Per-file rules beyond one row (unique ids, seq strictly increasing, direction links) are in docs/game-format-v1.json, dataset.workflow.

time.description: ISO 8601 with offset, when the operation happened

op.description: <area>.<verb>, e.g. actor.spawn, asset.create, code.edit, build.editor, user.direction; a few one-word ops (note, correction) also occur

target.description: what the operation acted on: an asset path, file, map, actor or area

reason.description: why, in the author's words at the time (an empty reason is reported as a warning)

reason_source.description: agent_note normally; user_direction on user.direction rows

source.description: what produced the row: the script (project-relative path) and its sha256, or nulls for operations done without a script

status.description: observed = done and seen in the editor; failed; unrecorded = done outside the recorder and logged after; reverted = undone later

direction.description: id of the user.direction row this operation acts on
